title: Mine&Dragons
body:
Mine&Dragons: Fragments of the World
Uncover the hidden secrets buried deep beneath the surface. Mine&Dragons is a fantasy Minecraft mod built for NeoForge 1.21.8 that enriches your world with mysterious gemstones and ancient ores.

Why download Mine&Dragons?
If you feel that Minecraft's vanilla caves lack mystery, this mod gives you new reasons to dig deep and brave dangerous biomes. Whether you are looking for magical light sources or tools forged from the void, this mod provides the first steps into a larger arcane journey.

Current Features (Work in Progress):
The mod focuses on the following materials and equipment:

Lumicite Ores & Tools: A radiant gemstone bursting with natural bioluminescence. You can find Lumicite Ore in the caves and craft a full set of glowing tools and weapons from it.
![Crafting Lumicite Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b601e476d42ba9ba2661ee53d86129a7ee7279a2.png)
Voidshard Ores & Tools: A pitch-black crystal linked to the absolute vacuum of the Void. Harvest Voidshard Ore to forge powerful, dark-themed equipment.
![Crafting Void Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddb618956ffcece6bade80f2e726ac6b59d1673a.png)
Legendary Gems: Currently, you can also find Runestone Fragments, Draconyx, and Frostvein crystals, which will be essential for future magical crafts and dragon-related items.
![Tool And Gems](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de75a8e7e48747f92fdf8952569b2d12dbcec1f6.png)
